recommended_representation_definition.REMOVE: dimension dropped from the joint representation entirely

holdout_protocol.backoff: cells with FIT support < 20 rows use the FIT global distribution

low_support_zones.definition: joint cells of the recommended representation with < 20 TRAIN rows

observed_sizing_outcomes.reason: target_total_bb/observed_sizing_bb only exist for RAISE/JAM, so they are consequences of the observed action and must not be used as predictors of it

provenance.certified_split_counts_note: certified_split_counts is population certification metadata; only the TRAIN hand ids are loaded, and no VALIDATION or TEST decision ever crosses the parser boundary

scope.purpose: TRAIN-only fragmentation diagnostic and representation justification (issue #421)

semantics.fragmentation_definition: observed level cardinality, effective cardinality (2**H), share of levels and rows below the support thresholds, and induced joint-cell growth
semantics.level_support_caveat: support counts rows, not independent hands; distinct_hands is reported alongside every level so correlated same-hand rows stay visible
semantics.predictive_gain_definition: reduction of held-out log loss (bits per decision) against the TRAIN FIT global action distribution
semantics.price_transform_note: price_to_pot is a monotone transform of pot_odds for a fixed to_call_bb, so it adds no information and is intentionally not audited as a separate dimension

verdict_semantics.AGGREGATE: real held-out gain, raw levels fragmented: coarsening proposed
verdict_semantics.KEEP: real held-out gain, raw levels already supported
verdict_semantics.REMOVE: no measurable held-out gain: only fragmentation cost remains

support_thresholds.fragmentation_trigger: raw levels are fragmented as soon as one observed level is below the support floor or the raw cardinality exceeds unusable_raw_levels
support_thresholds.remove_rule: max(absolute_floor, relative_floor * baseline_log_loss): a dimension must reduce held-out log loss by at least that many bits per decision to be informative
